name: Finale Emilia (Italy)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly, white above and light blue below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Finale Emilia (a castle above a swan on water) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Finale Emilia, a comune in Emilia-Romagna; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: divided diagonally white over light blue
